create_CUDAGraphWrapper: create a CUDAGraphWrapper to wrap a runnable with CUDA graph capturing and replaying for a given vllm config
build_CUDAGraphLogging: build a CUDAGraphLogging instance to aggregate and log CUDA graph metrics with configurable mode and capture sizes
test_CUDAGraphWrapper_call: test the CUDAGraphWrapper __call__ method to dispatch between capture and replay based on batch descriptor and runtime mode
review_CUDAGraphWrapper_clear_all_graphs: review the CUDAGraphWrapper.clear_all_graphs class method to clear captured graphs from all wrapper instances
summarize_CUDAGraphStat: summarize the CUDAGraphStat dataclass containing unpadded tokens, padded tokens, paddings count, and runtime mode
